An active PredicateDefinition declares signatures, cardinality, target intervals, state keys, authoritative writers, missingness and query evaluation. Reject incompatible overlapping resolved values; explicit interval splitting/supersession retains immutable prior revisions.

A March cash report received in June and an older report arriving later cannot rewrite current cash or silently replace a belief about a different target period; event/receipt/target/belief/record times remain separately inspectable.

Observation payload snapshots and hashes remain unchanged when world facts or author provenance change. MetricSample is an author result record and enters an actor view only through a declared observation channel.

requirements.title: Connect selected beliefs and intentions to actual choices
requirements.statement: Every modeled choice shall bind its decision-maker, represented institution, dated authority, resource owners, permitted information and executed decision procedure; selected goals, beliefs, plans and commitments shall influence decisions only through that procedure and retain inspectable reasons.

acceptance.given: A character occupying an office with a personal commitment and a mistaken belief about a material proposition
acceptance.when: A registered observation arrives and a decision is made
then: Institutional objectives and personal commitments remain separate; the controlled actor remains Pacifica's executive scope.
Observation receipt, credibility/update rule, resulting belief and affected plan are recorded; a true report need not be believed automatically.
Persisted plans can be active, suspended, abandoned, achieved or failed with supported reasons; unrealized intentions are not realized events.
Only selected propositions and characters are modeled in R0; unsupported psychology or inferred motives remain explicit author interpretation.

A DecisionContext pins person/collective, represented principal or personal capacity, dated roles/authority, resource ownership, control scope, permitted information, preferences and procedure. The controller cannot silently override an enabled personal commitment model.

A DecisionRecord identifies considered alternatives within the procedure's declared scope, used beliefs/goals/commitments, trade-offs/rejection reasons and randomness. Changing a relevant belief or commitment changes the selected example decision under the stated rule; merely attaching a motive afterward fails.

Officeholder substitution preserves institutional assets/liabilities while applying explicit personal-state rules. Plan status records distinguish external frustration, voluntary abandonment and success as perceived by the actor versus actual goal satisfaction.

requirements.title: Adjudicate attempts without leaking hidden information
requirements.statement: The engine shall separate perceived eligibility, selected attempts, actual adjudication, realized effects and disclosed observations, including rejection, delay, partial implementation and failure.

acceptance.given: Two worlds with identical actor observations and random addresses but different concealed counterparty resources
acceptance.when: Menus, previews, attempts and resolution are evaluated
then: Before permitted disclosure, actor-visible eligibility, messages and decisions match; hidden actual feasibility does not filter the policy's choices.
Actual outcomes may differ under declared rules, and only the configured observation channel discloses the difference.
Attempt, adjudication decision, resource effect and observation have distinct IDs and timestamps; no silent replacement action is introduced.
Registered phase ordering, negotiation rounds and tie rules are pinned and replayable.
Every attempt references its DecisionRecord; pre-resolution diagnostics and previews cannot dereference hidden facts through author-only provenance or MetricSample tables.

requirements.title: Scope lawful and supported exceptional conduct by actor
requirements.statement: Experiments shall bind lawful, apparent-authority or breach-exploration conduct to named actors/action families; perceived authorization, actual legality, intention, physical execution and discovery consequences shall remain distinct.

acceptance.given: A lawful Pacifica actor, an independently responding counterparty, and a physically possible action with concealed invalid authority
acceptance.when: Actor/action-family conduct bindings and registered disclosure/consequence rules are exercised
then: lawful retains strict lawful execution for the bound conduct: actual unauthorized execution is rejected, with hidden reasons withheld until permitted disclosure. Apparent-authority execution is explicitly excluded from this profile.

apparent_authority permits only a registered physically possible act believed authorized under the actor's pinned rule. Adjudication records actual illegality at execution, while the actor discovers it only through the registered channel; covered resistance, liability and cure rules apply.

breach_exploration permits only registered intentional breaches with consequence coverage. Unknown/disputed authority uses explicit hypotheses or unsupported status where adjudication needs resolved truth; neither exceptional profile manufactures consent.

Bindings identify actors/action families, dates and precedence; overlaps without precedence or missing bindings fail configuration. Pacifica may remain lawful while an independent counterparty follows a supported exceptional profile.

Physical limits, accounting and locked premises hold throughout. Later remedy preserves the earlier breach interval. All unsupported variants remain disabled and generated conduct does not approve canon.

requirements.title: Branch from a complete decision state
requirements.statement: The author shall branch at a recorded decision point using a complete checkpoint or deterministic reconstruction and a declared decision, premise or imposed-event intervention, preserving established history and explicit lineage.

acceptance.given: A saved path immediately before a consequential decision, with pending commitments and delayed reports
acceptance.when: The author forks and resumes it
then: Reconstruction includes stocks, rights, obligations, action/event queues, actor beliefs/memory/plans, observation history and random addresses; unchanged resumption reproduces the parent.
A decision intervention changes a supported Pacifica attempt using existing information; a premise change declares its effective and knowledge dates; an imposed event remains marked conditional.
Changes requiring an earlier cause fork before that cause; an author edit cannot rewrite an established prefix while claiming the same decision fork.
Matched exogenous draws remain aligned where valid, endogenous effects recompute, and the first consequential divergence and its support records are inspectable.
Imposed outcomes are excluded from ordinary policy-success assessment; selection/conditioning and branch modes remain in exports.

Checkpoints retain predicate revisions, immutable payloads, decision contexts, controller state, conduct bindings and population lineage. A one-off author decision override is labeled; it cannot be given a fabricated actor motive, and continuation follows the declared policy/plan update rule.

requirements.title: Discover varied story candidates and search explicit narrative targets
requirements.statement: R0 shall support open exploration, supported story-candidate views, narrative filters and spontaneous bookmarks before strategic pruning; R1 shall distinguish existential-history, policy-reliability and minimum-premise-change searches with explicit temporal semantics, populations and result statuses.

acceptance.given: A bounded generated population containing strategically dominated policies, causal alternatives and numeric variants of the same conflict, with no required author ending
acceptance.when: Open exploration, filtering, candidate selection and spontaneous bookmarking run
then: Open exploration requires neither a narrative target nor strategic objectives. Each generated history or reconstructible compact trace is offered to the candidate selector before strategic pruning; the bounded store reports selection rule, capacity, coverage and eviction.

Registered causal signatures distinguish actor goals, conflicts, frustrated plans, revelations and choices. Numeric/date jitter alone does not create a new story type; representative candidates link to actual histories. A dominated but causally distinct example is surfaced without the author naming its ending.

StoryCandidate is a derived view containing focal actor, goal, obstacle/conflict, choice, sacrifice, consequence and unresolved tension with typed supports. It creates no new motives or world effects and labels unsupported interpretation.

A bookmark can have null query/candidate references and a spontaneous selection reason; it retains immutable policy/history, assumptions and assessment/profile status after pruning and cluster changes.

R0 predicates use explicit temporal rules and return satisfied, violated, unresolved or unsupported. A history stopping in 1930 cannot satisfy no-default-through-1932. Candidate access never transfers future author predicates to actors.
Every filtered/candidate population declares membership, unit, selection and weighting. Narrative interest is neither probability nor strategic utility.

acceptance.given: A bounded domain with a rare supported narrative route, a reliable-policy target, allowed premise edits, incomplete histories and an exhaustively enumerable impossible query
then: Declare mode, target quantification, temporal expression, allowed interventions, sampling, evidence, population and budget. existential_history asks for a supported witness; policy_reliability compares target satisfaction on fresh unconditioned worlds; minimum_premise_change searches permitted edits using declared costs/order and ties.

A rare supported witness need not be reliable. Story sampling may target declared uncertain conditions with recorded selection/weight contracts, but never grants actor foresight, forced counterparties or policy control over random seeds. Premise packages remain separately assessed.

Distinguish found_supported, found_conditional, no_match_within_budget, unsatisfiable_within_exhaustive_scope and unsupported_query. Unresolved temporal predicates never pass; impossibility/minimality claims require the stated exhaustive bounded check.

Return causally distinct best-found routes and inspectable unsuccessful searches. Imposed-event histories are conditional consequence experiments, not supported witnesses that a policy generated the event.

Freeze selected policies and evaluate fresh unconditioned worlds before reporting ordinary distributions. Root-world, evaluation and branch denominators remain separate; targeted shares never establish unconditional success.

R1 existential-history search may rank supported decision/policy edits by explicit change costs without altering premises; such ranking needs units/order, bounds and ties and claims minimality only after exhaustive bounded checking.

requirements.title: Enforce mechanism applicability and provisional continuations
requirements.statement: Every active mechanism shall declare an executable applicability predicate, read/write ownership, evidence and counterexample tests; leaving its supported domain shall invalidate dependent claims or create an explicitly selected provisional continuation.

acceptance.given: A financing mechanism whose institutional or resource assumptions cease to hold
acceptance.when: A trajectory crosses the mechanism's validity boundary
then: The first applicability failure identifies mechanism, state/action, evidence scope and dependent outputs; the check runs during evolution as well as input validation.
The default is unsupported/stop for affected computation, with unaffected results retained under their scope; no silent extrapolation or inherited passing badge occurs.
An author can explicitly choose a registered provisional assumption with applicability and uncertainty limits; it creates a linked conditional continuation and cannot fabricate missing state.
Conditional status propagates through affected outputs and aggregations; such paths remain in the total denominator and cannot certify ordinary strategic rankings or historical probabilities.
Alternative structural models retain separate applicability and assessment summaries unless an explicit justified weighting contract permits aggregation.

A provisional continuation keeps its parent evaluation's unsupported status and root-world identity, creates a separately identified conditional branch/population and cannot silently replace a parent outcome or inflate its denominator.

requirements.title: Demonstrate usefulness for plot development
requirements.statement: Release evidence shall include author evaluation of attributable choices, causal alternatives, understandable branches and useful retained ideas on prepared and held-out writing questions, including open exploration and a manual-workflow comparator, alongside technical correctness and performance.

acceptance.given: A predeclared set of real Pacifica writing questions including one financing/commitment dilemma
acceptance.when: The author uses the R0 slice and reviews its outputs
then: M0 records the questions, expected useful tasks and author acceptance procedure before tuning outputs; examples are test proposals, not canon.
R0 demonstrates distinct supported causal alternatives, a choice attributable to a character/institution, a belief-driven plan change and an inspectable decision fork.
Record author judgments, time to first retained idea, explanation gaps and manual repair needed; no automatic story-quality score substitutes for author acceptance.
Retained ideas carry unresolved assumptions and consequences; failure of the agreed author gate leads to a scope/design revision before broad tooling or search-scale commitments.

The protocol reserves at least one supported-domain writing question from model/output tuning, includes an open-ended task with no desired ending, and compares against the author's notes/manual workflow with task/time scope recorded. Once revealed and used for tuning, that question is no longer held out.

The author assesses previously unconsidered causal possibilities, inspectable decision motives and ideas still useful after assumption disclosure. A prepared financing demonstration alone cannot pass the usefulness gate; no automated literary score replaces the author's decision.

acceptance.given: Strategy discovery and bounded narrative-condition search
acceptance.when: The author repeats the predeclared writing tasks
then: Review causal variety, meaningful agency, branch comprehensibility and useful retained ideas against the R0 workflow; report sample and protocol limits.
Neither 100,000 rollouts nor attractive prose substitutes for author acceptance; shortcomings are recorded before expansion.
Repeat open exploration and the manual-workflow comparison with a fresh held-out question if earlier assessment feedback informed development; report novelty, assumption disclosure and repair burden.

requirements.title: Resolve simultaneous commitments consistently
requirements.statement: The engine shall resolve simultaneous and sequential interactions through registered phases, resource reservations, allocation/tie rules and settlement semantics that are independent of incidental module or actor iteration order.

acceptance.given: Two contemporaneous offers competing for the same cash, collateral or transport capacity
acceptance.when: Interaction resolution is repeated under reordered actors and worker partitions
then: Both offers cannot spend the same resource; tentative reservations, partial allocation, release on refusal and settlement are explicitly accounted.
Negotiation order, priority, deterministic ties or addressed random ties are declared model rules, not consequences of array or module iteration.
Conditional agreements specify whether the bundle is atomic or permits declared partial execution; failures never create rights, cash or consent without their prerequisites.
Outputs and traces agree under incidental reorderings within the pinned contract; registration rejects conflicting state writers without a resolver.

required_checks: No dependency on a later release
Synchronized Markdown register and detailed statements
Action/profile and intervention-mode consistency across catalogs
Preserved fixture identity and documentation-only paths
Preserved requirement, acceptance, record and invariant identities
All nine v0.6 review recommendations traced

demonstrations.description: Independent reference: baseline plus accepted/refused/counteroffered credit, changed terms/dates, failed rollover and interim shortage; compare values and later feasibility.
Sketch a supported financing/commitment lever; show provisional 1,000/10,000-path targets, counts, coverage, current identity and offline replay; explicitly save a version.

Identical observations/randomness produce identical eligibility, previews, rejection messages before disclosure and pre-shock decisions despite different hidden facts; single/batch/partition runs retain addressed draws.
Compute a saved sketch and a changed input on supported Windows/Linux without Office, a network calculation service or a server database.
Interrupt publication around file/index boundaries and save from a stale tab; recover the last complete version and rebuild the index from manifests.
Discover at least 1,000 policies/100,000 generated paths with actual independent refusals, adaptive choices, reported total budgets and fresh assessment.
An enumerable multiobjective problem reproduces global and per-cell nondominated sets; bounded pruning and never/uncertain descriptor cases follow declared rules.

A counterparty cooperates under its own goals; hostile stress has separate plausibility bounds. Lost advantage is sensitivity. A seeded real model defect needs a reproducible counterexample before an exploit label.
Keep rare/terminal histories and empirical shares in R1; R2 narration rejects an invented motive even if its event ID and number are correct. Offline structured summaries remain usable.
A detailed funding shortage invalidates a recorded commitment in forensic mode; policy re-evaluation produces a new linked action/response history under matched external worlds.
Import exact six files twice; preserve six identities, 17 run labels and 14 distinct inputs, conditions and aliases; compare 87 annual periods/73 metrics plus finer schedules.
Fork a fixture's parameter from 1928, inspect removed loan/concession obligations, preserve C0 and keep absent North American denominators unavailable.
Apply a finance-skill proposal as validated model inputs and trace a detailed quantity to its source, derivation and instrument.
Inject a broken cash/debt identity and an unconfigured cycle; show the terms/residual or cycle path without inheriting an old success badge.
Validate disputed/unknown consent, contradictory claims and succession: preserve institution-owned obligations, individual identities, valid dates and actor-specific beliefs.

A pinned personal/institutional decision rule uses beliefs and competing commitments; its recorded reasons identify actual inputs and rejected alternatives. Changed relevant belief changes the choice; later attached motives cannot justify it.
Two simultaneous offers compete for one resource; reordering actors/modules preserves registered allocation, settlement and release of refused reservations.

Bind lawful conduct to Pacifica and supported exceptional conduct to an independent counterparty; test strict rejection, apparent authority with delayed discovery, intentional breach and later cure without invented consent.
Resume an unchanged decision state exactly, then fork a Pacifica decision, a dated premise and an imposed event separately; preserve prefix, hidden state and selection labels.

Open exploration surfaces a causally distinct dominated history before strategic pruning, supports a spontaneous bookmark and deduplicates numeric variants; R1 distinguishes witness, reliability and premise searches.
Cross an institutional applicability boundary, propagate unavailable claims, then explicitly choose a registered provisional continuation with conditional results and preserved denominator.

Evaluate prepared and open-ended writing tasks plus a supported question withheld from tuning against notes/manual workflow; record new causal ideas, assumption disclosure, repair and author acceptance before expansion.

Reports about March cash arrive out of order in June; current truth, target period, historical beliefs and immutable delivered payloads remain distinct. Overlapping resolved state conflicts fail validation.

Substitute an officeholder while preserving institutional liabilities; decision authority, private beliefs and commitments follow explicit bindings. MetricSample data cannot enter the actor view without an Observation channel.
A run censored in 1930 leaves no-default-through-1932 unresolved; distinguish exhausted search from exhaustively proved infeasibility, and a rare supported witness from policy reliability.

100 root worlds with 20 unsupported parent paths and 20 provisional continuations retain 100 parent evaluations and 120 branch executions; separate conditional results, retries and cache reuse without inventing independent evidence.

Two histories with similar financial outcomes but different frustrated plans remain distinct story candidates; numerical jitter of one conflict does not create another. Derived dramatic claims cite decisions and effects and never mutate the world.

review_traceability.recommendation: Bind people and institutions to executed decisions
Define predicate/state/time and immutable information semantics
Discover open causal alternatives before strategic pruning
Separate narrative search targets and incomplete-history results
Scope conduct and reconcile apparent authority with legality
Expose supported dramatic structure and actual decision reasons
Evaluate held-out and open writing tasks against manual work
Distinguish root-world evaluation and branch denominators

recommendations.recommendation: Separate author conditions and preserve interesting dominated histories
Represent selected character intention and belief
Adjudicate perceived versus actual feasibility, lawful/breach profiles and simultaneous resources
